packageRules.description: Skip TypeScript 7.0.x: `astro check` (@astrojs/check 0.9.10 peers typescript ^5 || ^6) refuses TypeScript 7.0 because the native compiler does not ship the programmatic API it relies on (https://github.com/withastro/roadmap/discussions/1321). Its replacement, @astrojs/ts-content-mapper, needs TypeScript 7.1+ (https://github.com/withastro/astro/tree/main/packages/language-tools/ts-content-mapper#usage), so 7.1 is allowed through and its PR is the cue to migrate.
